address: Sofitel Complex, 8 Duke Street, Queenstown, 9300, New Zealand
bio: There are times when only a steakhouse will do, especially a classic one complete with an open fireplace. A favourite since opening its doors in 2006, Jervois Steak House is found within the Sofitel Complex and occupies two floors, with a bar below the warmly lit main dining room. Along with grass- or grain-fed Angus beef from New Zealand, you’ll also find Wagyu cuts from Australia and Japan, all expertly cooked over charcoal and served with a wide selection of sauces and butters. Equal care has gone into the wine list, which offers over 40 wines by the glass.
